name: multi-paper-v1
note: Internal benchmark (not industry-standard). Written by hand from the papers' text: every label names the paper, page(s) and short evidence phrases located by reading the source pages, NOT from retriever output. A chunk is relevant for a group if it belongs to that paper, overlaps a labelled page, and contains at least one evidence phrase (whitespace/case/hyphen-normalised). Questions with several groups require evidence from EVERY group (cross-paper coverage).
